chapter.heading: Concluding Moral Directions
chapter.v:
Let brotherly
love continue. [1 Cor. 14:29]

Do not
forget to entertain strangers, for by so doing some have unwittingly entertained angels. [[Rom. 10:8-10];]

Remember the
prisoners as if chained with them—those who are mistreated—since you yourselves are in the body also.

Marriage is
honorable among all, and the bed undefiled; but fornicators and adulterers God will judge. [John 14:30;]

Let your
conduct be without covetousness; be content with such things as you have. For He Himself has said, “I will never leave you nor forsake you.” [John 3:31]

So we
may boldly say:“The Lord is my helper;I will not fear.What can man do to me?”Concluding Religious Directions [[1 Cor. 2:12-16]]

Remember those
who rule over you, who have spoken the word of God to you, whose faith follow, considering the outcome of their conduct. [1 John 3:10, 11,]

Jesus Christ
is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

Do not
be carried about with various and strange doctrines. For it is good that the heart be established by grace, not with foods which have not profited those who have been occupied with them. [Rom. 5:8 k Is.]

We have
an altar from which those who serve the tabernacle have no right to eat. [Titus 3:5]

For the
bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned outside the camp. [Matt. 18:33]

Therefore Jesus
also, that He might sanctify the people with His own blood, suffered outside the gate. [John 1:18;]

Therefore let
us go forth to Him, outside the camp, bearing His reproach. [John 14:20]

For here
we have no continuing city, but we seek the one to come. [John 1:14]

Therefore by
Him let us continually offer the sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of our lips, giving thanks to His name. [[Rom. 10:9];]

But do
not forget to do good and to share, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased. [[1 John 3:24]]

Obey those
who rule over you, and be submissive, for they watch out for your souls, as those who must give account. Let them do so with joy and not with grief, for that would be unprofitable for you.Prayer Requested [[James 2:13];]

Pray for
us; for we are confident that we have a good conscience, in all things desiring to live honorably.

But I
especially urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.Benediction, Final Exhortation, Farewell [1 John 4:10]

Now may
the God of peace who brought up our Lord Jesus from the dead, that great Shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant, [[1 John 2:4]] [1 Pet. 1:8;]

make you
complete in every good work to do His will, working in you what is well pleasing in His sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen. [Lev. 19:18;]

And I
appeal to you, brethren, bear with the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

Know that
our brother Timothy has been set free, with whom I shall see you if he comes shortly. [1 Thess. 4:9;]

Greet all
those who rule over you, and all the saints. Those from Italy greet you.

Grace be
with you all. Amen.
